mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) relative to its historical average is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when UNRATE > 4.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals an economic slowdown with inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
